gist.summary: Enter now accepts `?ref=text` in both the frontend referral beacon and `POST /api/referral`, so arrivals from legacy text migration links can be recorded like `?ref=image`. Referral tests now cover `text` for signed-out and signed-in visitors.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel garden, Polli guides a little paper link marked `?ref=text` toward a lime green (#ecf874) terminal, beside a code-plant growing in a flower pot. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears tiny librarian glasses and is small-to-medium sized within the scene, never oversized or dominating it. Strictly pixel art style, never realistic; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, and the emotionally warm lo-fi feel of Stardew Valley.
